Overview

Applied AI & GenAI for Education & Research earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from SIS & registries and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. Education & Research punishes generic deployments. learning analytics moves faster than batch cycles, GDPR / privacy regimes demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.
